suggestions.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
suggestions.description: A young hobbit and a fellowship of eight companions set out to destroy the One Ring before it falls into the hands of the Dark Lord Sauron. Peter Jackson's epic fantasy masterpiece launched one of cinema's greatest trilogies — breathtaking New Zealand landscapes, Howard Shore's iconic score, and a cast that brings Tolkien's world to life with unforgettable performances from Ian McKellen, Viggo Mortensen, and Elijah Wood.

suggestions.title: Whiplash
suggestions.description: A promising young drummer is driven to his breaking point by an abusive, perfectionist jazz instructor. Damien Chazelle's electrifying drama features J.K. Simmons in an Oscar-winning performance that's as terrifying as it is mesmerizing. The climactic drum solo is one of the most tense and thrilling sequences ever put on film. Not your typical musical — it's a psychological battle wrapped in jazz.

suggestions.title: Die Hard
suggestions.description: A New York cop battles a group of terrorists who have taken over a Los Angeles skyscraper during a Christmas party. John McTiernan's blueprint for the modern action movie — Bruce Willis as the everyman hero John McClane, Alan Rickman as cinema's suavest villain, and a relentless cat-and-mouse game through Nakatomi Plaza that invented the genre. Yippee-ki-yay.
